TeXPane 0.1.1

- Cmd/Ctrl+F now opens find and replace in the editor; Cmd/Ctrl+G and Shift+Cmd/Ctrl+G step through matches.
- Cmd/Ctrl+S recompile and the right-click auto-compile menu on the Recompile button (from 0.1.0 follow-ups).
- `\begin` / `\end` completion puts the cursor inside the braces and offers environments.
